name: indexer_topk_decode_bs1_real
description: DeepSeek-V4 sparse-attention indexer top-K selection at decode, BS=1, fp32, real captured logits. Select the indices of the k largest values of logits[0, :n_valid]. logits is stride-padded to npad=ceil(n/64)*64 with float32 min (pad can never enter the top-k). pre_idx holds the PREVIOUS decode step's top-k indices (temporal warm hint; overlap with the true top-k ranges 0.02-1.0, typically >0.5). Output: int32 indices, any order; ties at the k-th value boundary may be resolved either way.
